title: Graphics32 API Schema
description: Complete public API schema for Graphics32 exported from frontmatter YAML data

units.name: GR32
units.summary: Core foundation of the Graphics32 library containing 32-bit ARGB color definitions, base bitmap classes, and pixel utility routines.

classes.name: TBitmap32
classes.summary: Primary 32-bit ARGB bitmap class in Graphics32, providing VCL/LCL Canvas, GDI device context (HDC), and OS surface handle bindings.

constructors.name: Create
constructors.summary: Instantiates a new 32-bit bitmap object.

overloads.signature: constructor Create; overload; override;
overloads.summary: Creates an empty bitmap object with default dimensions (0x0).

overloads.signature: constructor Create(AWidth, AHeight: Integer); overload;
overloads.summary: Creates a bitmap object initialized with the specified width and height.

parameters.name: AWidth
parameters.description: Initial width of the bitmap in pixels.

parameters.name: AHeight
parameters.description: Initial height of the bitmap in pixels.

overloads.signature: constructor Create(ABackendClass: TCustomBackendClass); overload;
overloads.summary: Creates a TBitmap32 object with a custom backend surface class.

parameters.name: ABackendClass
parameters.description: Custom memory surface backend class (e.g. Memory, GDI, or MMF backend).

constructors.name: Destroy
constructors.summary: Disposes of the bitmap instance, releasing allocated pixel buffers, backend memory surfaces, and attached resamplers.

methods.name: AdvanceStippleCounter
methods.summary: Advances current stipple counter phase position by specified length in pixels.

methods.name: Assign
methods.summary: Copies pixel data, dimensions, and drawing properties from a source object or persistent bitmap.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Source object (typically another TCustomBitmap32 or TGraphic) to copy from.

methods.name: BeginLockUpdate
methods.summary: Supends update state changes and change notifications.

methods.name: BeginMeasuring
methods.summary: Begins measuring modified pixel regions and accumulates area change notifications.

parameters.name: Callback
parameters.description: Callback procedure invoked when measuring ends with the accumulated changed region rectangle.

methods.name: BeginUpdate
methods.summary: Increments the update counter to defer change notifications.

methods.name: BoundsRect
methods.summary: Returns a TRect structure representing the full pixel bounds of the bitmap.

returns.description: A TRect structure representing the full pixel bounds `(0, 0, Width, Height)` of the bitmap.

methods.name: Changed
methods.summary: Triggers change notifications for the entire bitmap or a specified sub-rectangle region.

overloads.signature: procedure Changed; overload; override;
overloads.summary: Triggers change notification across the entire bitmap surface.

overloads.signature: procedure Changed(const Area: TRect; const Info: Cardinal = AREAINFO_RECT); reintroduce; overload; virtual;
overloads.summary: Triggers change notification for a specified modified sub-rectangle region.

parameters.name: Area
parameters.description: Modified sub-rectangle area of the bitmap surface.

methods.name: ChangeSize
methods.summary: Protected virtual method performing low-level buffer reallocation and dimension updates.
methods.declaration: procedure ChangeSize(var Width, Height: Integer; NewWidth, NewHeight: Integer; ClearBuffer: Boolean = True); virtual;

parameters.name: ClearBuffer
parameters.description: When True, buffer content should be cleared.

methods.name: Clear
methods.summary: Clears the entire pixel buffer to transparent black (clNone32) or a specified TColor32 value.

overloads.signature: procedure Clear; overload; override;
overloads.summary: Clears all pixels in the bitmap to clNone32 ($00000000).

overloads.signature: procedure Clear(FillColor: TColor32); reintroduce; overload;
overloads.summary: Clears all pixels in the bitmap to the specified TColor32 fill color.

methods.name: CopyMapTo
methods.summary: Copies raw map buffer dimensions and pixel memory to a destination bitmap without firing change notifications.

parameters.name: Dst
parameters.description: Destination bitmap receiving the raw pixel buffer copy.

methods.name: Delete
methods.summary: Resets bitmap dimensions to zero and deallocates pixel buffer memory.

methods.name: DeleteCanvas
methods.summary: Frees and releases the internal VCL/LCL TCanvas instance allocated for this bitmap.

methods.name: DoChanged
methods.summary: Executes the OnChange event handler.

methods.name: Draw
methods.summary: Draws a source bitmap, sub-rectangle, or GDI device context (HDC) onto this bitmap using current DrawMode and CombineMode.

overloads.signature: procedure Draw(DstX, DstY: Integer; Src: TCustomBitmap32); overload;
overloads.summary: Draws the entire source bitmap at top-left pixel position (DstX, DstY).

parameters.name: DstX, DstY
parameters.description: Top-left destination coordinate on this bitmap.

overloads.signature: procedure Draw(DstX, DstY: Integer; const SrcRect: TRect; Src: TCustomBitmap32); overload;
overloads.summary: Draws a sub-rectangle from the source bitmap at top-left pixel position (DstX, DstY).

parameters.name: DstX, DstY
parameters.description: Top-left destination coordinate on this bitmap.

parameters.name: SrcRect
parameters.description: Source sub-rectangle on the source bitmap.

parameters.name: Src
parameters.description: Source bitmap to copy or blend pixels from.

overloads.signature: procedure Draw(const DstRect, SrcRect: TRect; Src: TCustomBitmap32); overload;
overloads.summary: Stretches and blends a sub-rectangle from the source bitmap into a destination rectangle.

parameters.name: DstRect
parameters.description: Target destination rectangle on this bitmap.

parameters.name: SrcRect
parameters.description: Source sub-rectangle on the source bitmap.

parameters.name: Src
parameters.description: Source bitmap to copy or blend pixels from.

overloads.signature: procedure Draw(const DstRect, SrcRect: TRect; hSrc: HDC); overload;
overloads.summary: Copies a sub-rectangle from an external GDI device context (HDC) into a destination rectangle on this bitmap.

parameters.name: SrcRect
parameters.description: Source rectangle in the external GDI device context.

parameters.name: hSrc
parameters.description: Handle to the source GDI device context.

methods.name: DrawTo
methods.summary: Draws this bitmap onto a destination bitmap or GDI device context (HDC).

overloads.signature: procedure DrawTo(Dst: TCustomBitmap32); overload;
overloads.summary: Draws this entire bitmap onto destination bitmap at (0, 0).

overloads.signature: procedure DrawTo(Dst: TCustomBitmap32; DstX, DstY: Integer); overload;
overloads.summary: Draws this entire bitmap onto destination bitmap at (DstX, DstY).

overloads.signature: procedure DrawTo(hDst: HDC; DstX: Integer = 0; DstY: Integer = 0); overload;
overloads.summary: Renders this bitmap onto a target GDI device context (HDC) at top-left position (DstX, DstY).

overloads.signature: procedure DrawTo(hDst: HDC; const DstRect, SrcRect: TRect); overload;
overloads.summary: Stretches a sub-rectangle of this bitmap onto a target GDI device context (HDC) rectangle.

methods.name: Empty
methods.summary: Returns True if either Width or Height of the bitmap is zero.

returns.description: Returns `True` if the bitmap has zero area or an unallocated pixel buffer; otherwise `False`.

methods.name: EndLockUpdate
methods.summary: Resumes update state changes and change notifications.

methods.name: EndMeasuring
methods.summary: Concludes area change measurement and invokes the registered measuring callback procedure.

methods.name: EndUpdate
methods.summary: Decrements the update counter and triggers change notification if modified.

methods.name: FillRect
methods.summary: Fills a rectangular area with a specified 32-bit ARGB color using integer coordinates or TRect bounds, supporting optional boundary clipping and alpha blending.

methods.name: FlipHorz
methods.summary: Flips pixel contents horizontally (left to right).

parameters.name: Dst
parameters.description: Optional destination bitmap. If nil, flips in-place.

methods.name: FlipVert
methods.summary: Flips pixel contents vertically (top to bottom).

parameters.name: Dst
parameters.description: Optional destination bitmap. If nil, flips in-place.

methods.name: FrameRect
methods.summary: Draws 1-pixel wide rectangular outline frames around specified coordinates or TRect bounds with optional clipping, alpha blending, and stippling.

methods.name: GetPlatformBackendClass
methods.summary: Returns the default platform-specific backend class for TBitmap32.

methods.name: GetStippleColor
methods.summary: Evaluates and returns current stipple color sample at active stipple phase.

parameters.name: Advance
parameters.description: If True, advances StippleCounter after reading color.

returns.description: The 32-bit ARGB `TColor32` stipple pattern color at the current position.

methods.name: HorzLine
methods.summary: Draws fast horizontal 1-pixel wide lines across integer or fixed-point coordinates with optional boundary clipping, alpha blending, and stippling.

parameters.name: X1, Y, X2
parameters.description: Start X, Y row, and end X coordinates.

methods.name: Line
methods.summary: Draws 1-pixel wide line segments between specified coordinates using integer, fixed-point, or floating-point positioning with optional clipping, alpha blending, anti-aliasing, and stippling.

parameters.name: L
parameters.description: If True, includes the last pixel.

methods.name: LineTo
methods.summary: Draws 1-pixel wide line segments from the current pen position to target coordinates using integer, fixed-point, or floating-point positioning, updating pen position afterwards.

methods.name: LoadFromFile
methods.summary: Loads bitmap image data from a specified file path.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: Full file path of the image file to load.

methods.name: LoadFromResourceID
methods.summary: Loads bitmap data from an executable module resource by integer resource ID.
methods.declaration: procedure LoadFromResourceID(Instance: THandle; ResID: Integer; ResType: TResourceType = RT_BITMAP);

methods.name: LoadFromResourceName
methods.summary: Loads bitmap data from an executable module resource by string resource name.
methods.declaration: procedure LoadFromResourceName(Instance: THandle; const ResName: string; ResType: TResourceType = RT_BITMAP);

methods.name: LoadFromStream
methods.summary: Loads bitmap image data from a stream.

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description: Stream containing encoded bitmap image data.

methods.name: Lock
methods.summary: Acquires the internal critical section lock.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.summary: Sets the current pen position for subsequent LineTo drawing operations using integer, fixed-point, or floating-point coordinates.

methods.name: PropertyChanged
methods.summary: Notifies the bitmap and active backend instance that a property setting has been modified.

methods.name: RaiseRectTS
methods.summary: Draws a 3D bevelled button/panel edge around a rectangle.

overloads.signature: procedure RaiseRectTS(X1, Y1, X2, Y2: Integer; Contrast: Integer); overload;
overloads.summary: Draws 3D bevel specified by integer coordinates.

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: Bevel highlight and shadow contrast intensity.

overloads.signature: procedure RaiseRectTS(const ARect: TRect; Contrast: Integer); overload;
overloads.summary: Draws 3D bevel specified by TRect.

methods.name: ReleaseBackend
methods.summary: Detaches and returns the active TCustomBackend instance without freeing it.

returns.description: The previous [[TCustomBackend]] instance detached from the bitmap.

methods.name: RenderText
methods.summary: Renders anti-aliased text directly into the bitmap buffer using specified color.

overloads.signature: procedure RenderText(X, Y: Integer; const Text: string; Color: TColor32; AntiAlias: boolean); overload;
overloads.summary: Renders text at (X, Y) with optional anti-aliasing.

parameters.name: Color
parameters.description: Color32 value used to draw text.

parameters.name: AntiAlias
parameters.description: Enables or disables anti-aliasing for font rendering.

overloads.signature: procedure RenderText(X, Y: Integer; const Text: string; Color: TColor32); overload;
overloads.summary: Renders text at (X, Y) using specified Color32 color with font's current anti-aliasing settings.

parameters.name: Color
parameters.description: Color32 value used to draw text.

methods.name: ResetAlpha
methods.summary: Resets alpha values of all pixels to $FF (fully opaque) or a specified alpha value.

overloads.signature: procedure ResetAlpha; overload;
overloads.summary: Resets the alpha component of all pixels in the bitmap to $FF (fully opaque).

overloads.signature: procedure ResetAlpha(const AlphaValue: Byte); overload;
overloads.summary: Resets the alpha component of all pixels in the bitmap to AlphaValue.

methods.name: ResetClipRect
methods.summary: Resets the clipping rectangle (ClipRect) to cover the full dimensions of the bitmap.

methods.name: Resized
methods.summary: Triggers resize processing and fires OnResize.

methods.name: Roll
methods.summary: Scrolls/shifts pixel contents horizontally and vertically with optional background fill.
methods.declaration: procedure Roll(Dx, Dy: Integer; FillBack: Boolean; FillColor: TColor32);

parameters.name: Dx, Dy
parameters.description: Horizontal and vertical pixel scroll deltas.

parameters.name: FillBack
parameters.description: If True, fills exposed empty areas with FillColor.

parameters.name: FillColor
parameters.description: Color used for filling exposed background areas.

methods.name: Rotate180
methods.summary: Rotates bitmap contents 180 degrees.

parameters.name: Dst
parameters.description: Optional destination bitmap. If nil, rotates in-place.

methods.name: Rotate270
methods.summary: Rotates bitmap contents 270 degrees clockwise (90 degrees counter-clockwise).

parameters.name: Dst
parameters.description: Optional destination bitmap. If nil, rotates in-place.

methods.name: Rotate90
methods.summary: Rotates bitmap contents 90 degrees clockwise.

parameters.name: Dst
parameters.description: Optional destination bitmap. If nil, rotates in-place.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.summary: Saves bitmap image data to a file on disk in BMP/DIB format.

overloads.signature: procedure SaveToFile(const FileName: string); overload; virtual;
overloads.summary: Saves bitmap to a file using default BMP header version.

overloads.signature: procedure SaveToFile(const FileName: string; SaveTopDown: Boolean); overload; virtual;
overloads.summary: Saves bitmap to a file with specified scanline orientation.

overloads.signature: procedure SaveToFile(const FileName: string; SaveTopDown: Boolean; InfoHeaderVersion: TInfoHeaderVersion); overload; virtual;
overloads.summary: Saves bitmap to a file specifying scanline orientation and BMP header version.

methods.name: SaveToStream
methods.summary: Saves bitmap image data to a stream in BMP/DIB format.

overloads.signature: procedure SaveToStream(Stream: TStream; SaveTopDown: Boolean = False); overload; virtual;
overloads.summary: Saves bitmap to a stream with optional top-down scanline orientation.

parameters.name: SaveTopDown
parameters.description: If True, writes scanlines in top-down order instead of bottom-up.

overloads.signature: procedure SaveToStream(Stream: TStream; SaveTopDown: Boolean; InfoHeaderVersion: TInfoHeaderVersion); overload; virtual;
overloads.summary: Saves bitmap to a stream specifying scanline orientation and header format version.

parameters.name: SaveTopDown
parameters.description: If True, writes scanlines in top-down order.

parameters.name: InfoHeaderVersion
parameters.description: BMP header format version (InfoHeaderVersion1 to InfoHeaderVersion5).

methods.name: SetHeight
methods.summary: Protected write method for the Height property.

methods.name: SetPixelT
methods.summary: Sets a pixel color using current DrawMode and CombineMode blending rules.

overloads.signature: procedure SetPixelT(X, Y: Integer; Value: TColor32); overload;
overloads.summary: Sets pixel at coordinates (X, Y) using blending rules.

overloads.signature: procedure SetPixelT(var Ptr: PColor32; Value: TColor32); overload;
overloads.summary: Sets pixel at pointer reference Ptr using blending rules.

methods.name: SetPixelTS
methods.summary: Sets a pixel color with boundary clipping using current DrawMode and CombineMode blending rules.
methods.declaration: procedure SetPixelTS(X, Y: Integer; Value: TColor32);

methods.name: SetSize
methods.summary: Resizes the map to new dimensions.
methods.declaration: function SetSize(NewWidth, NewHeight: Integer; ClearBuffer: Boolean = True): Boolean; virtual;

parameters.name: ClearBuffer
parameters.description: When True (default), clears buffer contents on resize.

returns.description: Returns `True` if dimensions were modified or buffer reallocated; otherwise `False`.

methods.name: SetSizeFrom
methods.summary: Copies dimensions from another object.
methods.declaration: function SetSizeFrom(Source: TPersistent; ClearBuffer: Boolean = True): Boolean;

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Source object (typically a TCustomMap instance) to copy dimensions from.

parameters.name: ClearBuffer
parameters.description: When True (default), clears buffer contents on resize.

returns.description: Returns `True` if map dimensions were updated to match the source object; otherwise `False`.

methods.name: SetStipple
methods.summary: Configures custom color array pattern for stippled line drawing.

overloads.signature: procedure SetStipple(const NewStipple: TArrayOfColor32); overload;
overloads.summary: Sets stipple pattern from dynamic array of TColor32.

overloads.signature: procedure SetStipple(const NewStipple: array of TColor32); overload;
overloads.summary: Sets stipple pattern from open array of TColor32.

methods.name: SetWidth
methods.summary: Protected write method for the Width property.

methods.name: TextExtent
methods.summary: Calculates the pixel width and height dimensions of a text string when rendered using current Font.

returns.description: A TSize record containing calculated width (cX) and height (cY) in pixels.

methods.name: TextHeight
methods.summary: Returns the height in pixels of a text string when rendered using current Font.

returns.description: Height in pixels.

methods.name: Textout
methods.summary: Renders text string onto the bitmap surface at specified coordinates or bounding rectangle using the current Font.

overloads.signature: procedure Textout(X, Y: Integer; const Text: string); overload;
overloads.summary: Renders a text string at position (X, Y).

parameters.name: X, Y
parameters.description: Top-left destination pixel coordinate for text rendering.

overloads.signature: procedure Textout(X, Y: Integer; const ClipRect: TRect; const Text: string); overload;
overloads.summary: Renders a text string at position (X, Y) constrained within a clipping rectangle.

parameters.name: X, Y
parameters.description: Top-left destination pixel coordinate for text rendering.

overloads.signature: procedure Textout(var DstRect: TRect; const Flags: Cardinal; const Text: string); overload;
overloads.summary: Renders formatted text within a destination rectangle using Win32 API DT_* formatting flags.

parameters.name: DstRect
parameters.description: Destination rectangle for text layout and rendering.

parameters.name: Flags
parameters.description: DrawText formatting flags (e.g. DT_CENTER, DT_WORDBREAK, DT_CALCRECT).

methods.name: TextWidth
methods.summary: Returns the width in pixels of a text string when rendered using current Font.

returns.description: Width in pixels.

methods.name: TileTo
methods.summary: Tiles a sub-rectangle of this bitmap repeatedly onto a target GDI device context (HDC).
methods.declaration: procedure TileTo(hDst: HDC; const DstRect, SrcRect: TRect; MaxTileSize: integer = 1024);

parameters.name: DstRect
parameters.description: Target destination rectangle to fill with repeating tiles.

parameters.name: SrcRect
parameters.description: Source sub-rectangle of this bitmap used as the tile unit.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.summary: Releases the internal critical section lock.

methods.name: UpdateFont
methods.summary: Notifies the backend that font property changes have occurred and updates font settings.

methods.name: VertLine
methods.summary: Draws fast vertical 1-pixel wide lines across integer or fixed-point coordinates with optional boundary clipping, alpha blending, and stippling.

parameters.name: X, Y1, Y2
parameters.description: X column, start Y, and end Y coordinates.

properties.name: Backend
properties.summary: Active rendering surface backend instance managing surface handles and memory.
properties.declaration: property Backend: TCustomBackend read FBackend write SetBackend;

properties.name: BitmapInfo
properties.summary: Retrieves the read-only GDI TBitmapInfo header structure associated with the backend surface.

properties.name: Bits
properties.summary: Pointer to the contiguous raw 32-bit ARGB pixel memory buffer.

properties.name: Canvas
properties.summary: Provides a VCL/LCL TCanvas instance bound to the bitmap's GDI device context (HDC).

properties.name: CanvasAllocated
properties.summary: Indicates whether a VCL/LCL TCanvas instance is currently allocated for this bitmap.

properties.name: Clipping
properties.summary: Read-only flag indicating whether ClipRect restricts drawing within the bitmap bounds.

properties.name: ClipRect
properties.summary: Clipping rectangle restricting pixel rendering operations.
properties.declaration: property ClipRect: TRect read FClipRect write SetClipRect;

properties.name: CombineMode
properties.summary: Specifies pixel color combination blend mode.
properties.declaration: property CombineMode: TCombineMode read FCombineMode write SetCombineMode default cmBlend;

properties.name: DrawMode
properties.summary: Specifies drawing mode rules (dmOpaque, dmBlend, dmCustom).
properties.declaration: property DrawMode: TDrawMode read FDrawMode write SetDrawMode default dmOpaque;

properties.name: Font
properties.summary: Specifies or retrieves the VCL/LCL font used when rendering text onto the Canvas.
properties.declaration: property Font: TFont read GetFont write SetFont;

properties.name: Handle
properties.summary: Retrieves the GDI bitmap surface handle (HBITMAP) for OS API interoperability.

properties.name: HDC
properties.summary: Retrieves the GDI Device Context handle (HDC) associated with the bitmap backend.

properties.name: Height
properties.summary: Specifies vertical map dimension.
properties.declaration: property Height: Integer read FHeight write SetHeight;

properties.name: LockCount
properties.summary: Returns the current nesting level of thread locks.

properties.name: LockUpdateCount
properties.summary: Returns the current nesting level of BeginLockUpdate calls.

properties.name: MasterAlpha
properties.summary: Global master alpha scaling factor applied during drawing operations.
properties.declaration: property MasterAlpha: Cardinal read FMasterAlpha write SetMasterAlpha default $FF;

properties.name: MeasuringMode
properties.summary: Read-only flag indicating whether area change measurement is active.

properties.name: Modified
properties.summary: Indicates whether modifications occurred while updates were suspended.

properties.name: OuterColor
properties.summary: Color value returned when sampling out-of-bounds coordinates in safe mode.
properties.declaration: property OuterColor: TColor32 read FOuterColor write FOuterColor default 0;

properties.name: PenColor
properties.summary: Color value used for pen drawing operations (MoveTo, LineTo).
properties.declaration: property PenColor: TColor32 read FPenColor write FPenColor;

properties.name: PenPos
properties.summary: Current integer pen position.
properties.declaration: property PenPos: TPoint read GetPenPos write SetPenPos;

properties.name: PenPosF
properties.summary: Current 16.16 fixed-point pen position.
properties.declaration: property PenPosF: TFixedPoint read GetPenPosF write SetPenPosF;

properties.name: Pixel
properties.summary: Indexed pixel access properties for reading and writing 32-bit ARGB pixel values across integer, fixed-point, and floating-point coordinates.

properties.name: PixelPtr
properties.summary: Pointer to specific pixel memory location at integer coordinates [X, Y].
properties.declaration: property PixelPtr[X, Y: Integer]: PColor32 read GetPixelPtr;

properties.name: RefCount
properties.summary: Retrieves the current reference count for the instance.

properties.name: RefCounted
properties.summary: Determines whether lifetime is controlled by reference counting.
properties.declaration: property RefCounted: Boolean read FRefCounted write FRefCounted;

properties.name: Resampler
properties.summary: Active resampler engine instance associated with this bitmap.
properties.declaration: property Resampler: TCustomResampler read FResampler write SetResampler;

properties.name: ResamplerClassName
properties.summary: Class name string of current resampler engine.
properties.declaration: property ResamplerClassName: string read GetResamplerClassName write SetResamplerClassName;

properties.name: ScanLine
properties.summary: Pointer to the starting pixel memory location for scanline row Y.
properties.declaration: property ScanLine[Y: Integer]: PColor32Array read GetScanLine;

properties.name: StippleCounter
properties.summary: Current phase position index along stipple pattern array.
properties.declaration: property StippleCounter: Single read FStippleCounter write FStippleCounter;

properties.name: StippleStep
properties.summary: Step increment distance for stipple pattern evaluation.
properties.declaration: property StippleStep: Single read FStippleStep write FStippleStep;

properties.name: UpdateCount
properties.summary: Returns the current nesting level of BeginUpdate calls.

properties.name: Width
properties.summary: Specifies horizontal map dimension.
properties.declaration: property Width: Integer read FWidth write SetWidth;

properties.name: WrapMode
properties.summary: Specifies coordinate wrapping mode (wmClamp, wmRepeat, wmMirror).
properties.declaration: property WrapMode: TWrapMode read FWrapMode write SetWrapMode default wmClamp;

events.name: OnAreaChanged
events.summary: Fired when a specific sub-rectangle region of the pixel buffer is modified.
events.declaration: property OnAreaChanged: TAreaChangedEvent read FOnAreaChanged write FOnAreaChanged;

events.name: OnChange
events.summary: Fired when the object state changes.
events.declaration: property OnChange: TNotifyEvent read FOnChange write FOnChange;

events.name: OnHandleChanged
events.summary: Fired when the OS GDI bitmap surface handle (Handle) is changed or re-allocated.
events.declaration: property OnHandleChanged: TNotifyEvent read FOnHandleChanged write FOnHandleChanged;

events.name: OnPixelCombine
events.summary: Custom pixel combination event fired when DrawMode is set to dmCustom.
events.declaration: property OnPixelCombine: TPixelCombineEvent read FOnPixelCombine write FOnPixelCombine;

events.name: OnResize
events.summary: Fired when map dimensions change.
events.declaration: property OnResize: TNotifyEvent read FOnResize write FOnResize;

classes.name: TCustomBackend
classes.declaration:
type
  TCustomBackend = class(TThreadPersistent)
    ...
  TCustomBackendClass = class of TCustomBackend;
classes.summary: Abstract base class for bitmap surface backends in Graphics32, managing raw pixel memory allocations and platform-specific surface handles.

constructors.name: Create
constructors.summary: Initializes a new instance of TCustomBackend, optionally setting the owner bitmap.

overloads.signature: constructor Create; overload; override;
overloads.summary: Initializes a standalone TCustomBackend instance.

overloads.signature: constructor Create(Owner: TCustomBitmap32); reintroduce; overload; virtual;
overloads.summary: Initializes a TCustomBackend instance and sets it as the active backend of Owner.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The bitmap instance that owns and uses this backend.

constructors.name: Destroy
constructors.summary: Disposes of the object instance, releasing any allocated resources.

methods.name: Assign
methods.summary: Copies pixel buffer memory and dimensions from another backend instance.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Source backend instance to copy from.

methods.name: BeginLockUpdate
methods.summary: Supends update state changes and change notifications.

methods.name: BeginUpdate
methods.summary: Increments the update counter to defer change notifications.

methods.name: Changed
methods.summary: Notifies listeners that the object state has changed.

methods.name: ChangeSize
methods.summary: Resizes the surface buffer to specified dimensions.
methods.declaration: procedure ChangeSize(out Width, Height: Integer; NewWidth, NewHeight: Integer; ClearBuffer: Boolean = True); virtual;

parameters.name: Width, Height
parameters.description: Output parameters updated with the new width and height.

parameters.name: ClearBuffer
parameters.description: If True (default), clears new surface buffer to zero.

methods.name: Changing
methods.summary: Protected virtual method that fires the OnChanging event prior to surface modification.

methods.name: Clear
methods.summary: Deallocates the surface buffer and resets dimensions to zero.

methods.name: DoChanged
methods.summary: Executes the OnChange event handler.

methods.name: Empty
methods.summary: Returns True if the backend surface buffer is unallocated or empty.

returns.description: Returns `True` if the backend surface is empty or unallocated; otherwise `False`.

methods.name: EndLockUpdate
methods.summary: Resumes update state changes and change notifications.

methods.name: EndUpdate
methods.summary: Decrements the update counter and triggers change notification if modified.

methods.name: FinalizeSurface
methods.summary: Protected virtual method overridden by concrete backends to deallocate surface memory and OS handles.

methods.name: InitializeSurface
methods.summary: Protected virtual method overridden by concrete backends to allocate surface memory and OS handles.
methods.declaration: procedure InitializeSurface(NewWidth, NewHeight: Integer; ClearBuffer: Boolean); virtual;

parameters.name: NewWidth, NewHeight
parameters.description: Dimensions of the new surface to allocate.

parameters.name: ClearBuffer
parameters.description: If True, initializes allocated pixel memory to zero.

methods.name: Lock
methods.summary: Acquires the internal critical section lock.

methods.name: Unlock

properties.name: Bits
properties.summary: Pointer to the contiguous 32-bit ARGB pixel memory buffer managed by this backend.

properties.name: LockCount
properties.summary: Returns the current nesting level of thread locks.

properties.name: LockUpdateCount
properties.summary: Returns the current nesting level of BeginLockUpdate calls.

properties.name: Modified
properties.summary: Indicates whether modifications occurred while updates were suspended.

properties.name: RefCount
properties.summary: Retrieves the current reference count for the instance.
